symptom: Global policy could reduce experiment_every to 2 when active tasks dropped below the minimum target, causing the daemon to hit the heavy evolution lane exactly during execution recovery.
impact: daemon cycles became stale while runtime throughput was still low
ordinary queued tasks stopped advancing because evolution monopolized the cycle budget
uptime-based acceptance could not be reached despite healthy guard status
fix: set cadence_policy.experiment_every to 0 when active_task_count < min_active_tasks
resume experiments only after runtime task pressure recovers above the minimum target
